purpose: Provide a public-safe, transformer-readable feature packet for cross-source analysis without claiming access to hidden model states or private corpus bytes.

transformer_boundary.allowed_input: observable features, retrieved source text/metadata, public provenance signals, declared external similarity metrics, and opaque private commitments

dynamic_weighting.evidence_rule: Evidence dimensions remain an orthogonal gate and are not collapsed into content similarity.
dynamic_weighting.anti_circularity: A feature derived from the candidate claim cannot independently corroborate that same claim.

public_source_adapters.purpose: ChatGPT web-search behavior, citation and source-review boundary
public_source_adapters.public_observation: ChatGPT search may return cited web sources, and users are advised to verify source support, date, and authority because results can be incomplete, outdated, or incorrect.

public_source_adapters.purpose: OpenAI image/audio provenance signals and negative-result boundary
public_source_adapters.public_observation: Supported OpenAI-generated images can carry C2PA and SynthID signals; provenance signals indicate origin context but do not by themselves establish accuracy, legal ownership, or unedited state.

public_source_adapters.purpose: Optional declared external embedding or grader method reference
public_source_adapters.public_observation: Any external embedding/similarity score must declare the exact method/model and remains a derived feature, not provider-authorship proof.

pairwise_relation_tensor.rule: Pairwise relations may rank or cluster nodes but may not merge node identities or erase provenance boundaries.

private_hash_bridge.public_side_allowed: commitment-derived navigation and explicitly exported aggregate features only

F_ok: observable feature vectors can be supplied to ChatGPT as structured context
site conditions and provenance can be represented orthogonally to semantic similarity
public and private data can meet through opaque commitments and exported aggregate features
F_gap: real Conversations Chunky vector values remain private-side TOKEN_VAZIO in this public artifact
provider-internal transformer states are not exposed by this contract
other provider-specific source adapters require independent public evidence
